query: How do I download a capital-gains statement?

hits.section: Steps to request your ELSS Statement:
hits.text: Go to your profile. Select the 'Reports' option. Under 'Tax', find 'Mutual Fund - Capital Gains'. Choose the financial year and click 'Download'. Click the button below to go directly to the 'Reports' section.

hits.section: Where can I get the tax proof for section 80C?
hits.text: You can request your tax proof for Section 80C by downloading the Mutual Fund-ELSS statement.
